problem_or_trigger: An instantaneous derivative suggests a direction.
principle: Use a local mechanism result to form a falsifiable hypothesis; a local acceleration derivative does not identify full-horizon task capability.
assumptions: Check the frozen model, input binding and method admission.
applicability: Model-based tendon-robot research; cross-task transfer unverified.
diagnostic_questions: Is the derivative above the signal floor and consistent across scales?
Is the state/input scope relevant to the proposed full-task observation?
possible_actions: Choose a legal contrast and matched task-level test with an explicit weakening observation.
Retain unresolved directions rather than inventing a sign.
expected_observations: Reliable local sign plus matched task improvement supports only that tested contrast.
No task improvement or inconsistent derivatives weakens the proposed link.
cannot_conclude: Guaranteed descent over an untested finite step
validation_status: Conditional method; no cross-task success guarantee.
